title: Notification off disables Send; no permission hides it
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor with edit-customer permission (which governs sending), on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. Open Customers > Maintenance reminders and use a row's Contact button to open the contact card. Seed a worklist row: enrol an asset (asset Maintenance tab -> Enrol) whose customer has contact details.
  3. A customer whose "Maintenance notifications" setting is OFF; and access to a user WITHOUT edit-customer permission.
custom_steps:
1. Open the card for a customer whose notification setting is off and read the send control and any reason.
  2. Confirm the row still appears on the worklist and nothing is hidden from it because of the setting.
  3. Sign in as a user without edit-customer permission and open the same card; look for Send reminder.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • With the notification setting off, Send reminder is disabled with the reason shown beside it (not hidden); the row still appears and the send action names that setting - an advisor never presses send and gets silence.
  • Nothing is hidden from the worklist because of the setting; it affects sending only.
  • A user without edit-customer permission does not see Send reminder at all (hidden, not disabled).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10571 (S14, Contact the customer from a row); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S14; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S14-N1: “Where the customer's notification setting is off, Send reminder is disabled with the reason shown beside it, not hidden”
  • S14-R9: “Where the customer's notification setting is off, the row still appears and the send action is unavailable, naming that setting as the reason. An advisor must never press send and get silence”
  • S14-N5: “Nothing is hidden from the worklist because of the notification setting. It affects sending and nothing else”
  • S14-R10: “Sending by hand follows the permission to edit a customer ... A user without it does not see Send reminder at all, hidden rather than disabled, because it is not something they can fix from the card”

AUTOMATION: HOLD - not yet build-verified on a Maintenance Reminders QA build (feature ships behind the maintenance_reminders flag)
